title: Length bounds for binary increment
statement: For every finite binary word $b$ written least-significant bit first, its increment has length at most $|b|+1$, and the number of leading $1$ bits of $b$ is at most the length of its increment.
replaced:
For every binary word $b$ (least-significant bit first), the incremented word
has length at most $|b| + 1$, and the carry length of $b$ is at most the length
of the incremented word.
